title: Bar Juice 5000 Pineapple Coconut 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Bar Juice 5000 Pineapple Coconut Nic Salt channels warm, beachy vibes with this sun-soaked tropical duo. Sweet, tangy Pineapple brings a bright, juicy top note, mellowed by the soft, creamy essence of Coconut underneath. The result is a breezy, fruit-forward vape that evokes a holiday cocktail—without ever becoming too rich or overpowering. With its 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid offers precise flavour delivery and subtle vapour output, making it ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and vape pens. The nicotine salt formula absorbs quickly into the bloodstream and delivers a tactile yet smooth throat hit, helping manage cravings with ease. Bar Juice 5000 Nic Salts replicate the UK’s favourite bar-style flavours but in a refillable format that’s far less wasteful. Choose from 5mg, 10mg or 20mg nicotine strengths to suit your preference.
